posts.content: 【⚡️Breaking】Claude Opus 4.8登場。Opus 4.7のハイエンド版で価格据え置き。コードのバグ見逃し率が4.7比で約1/4に低減。ただし体感はやや遅め。SWE-Bench Pro 69.2%（首位）、Knowledge Worker GDPval-AA 1890（GPT-5.5の1769を圧倒）、Computer operation 83.4%、Financial 53.9%（いずれも首位）。Fast modeは約2.5倍速・3倍安。ベンチマーク6勝1敗の堅実進化。

posts.content: New in Claude Code (research preview): dynamic workflows. Claude writes an orchestration script on the fly, then spins up a large fleet of coordinated subagents in parallel to take on your most complex tasks. Use the word "workflow" in a prompt to get started.
